name: Hanniel
overview: Hanniel was a male member of the tribe of Asher, identified specifically as the son of Ulla, also known as Jephunneh, according to 1 Chronicles 7:39. Beyond this paternal connection, the biblical record provides no additional personal details or notes about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Hanniel means 'favored of God [El],' reflecting a theophoric element that acknowledges divine favor. This proper name is not indicated as being given directly by God, but it carries a meaningful recognition of God's favor as understood in Hebrew tradition.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Hanniel as the son of Jephunneh, establishing a direct paternal relationship. No other familial connections are documented beyond this link in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Hanniel's significance in the biblical narrative is primarily genealogical, serving to trace the lineage within the tribe of Asher. His mention as the son of Jephunneh in 1 Chronicles 7:39 situates him within the broader context of Israelite tribal history, contributing to the preservation of God's covenant people through recorded ancestry.
